description:
Update article text content from markdown. Use <SCREENSHOT {id}> placeholders to position screenshots.
Screenshots in the markdown are kept. Screenshots removed from markdown are deleted. Order in markdown defines final order. Keep each <EMBED {id}> placeholder unchanged, or what it stands for is deleted.
Get the current article first with get_article, modify the markdown, then call this with the article_version of the article you edited (from get_article, or from your last add_article_media / update_article_media / update_article on it). If the article changed since, the update is refused: read it again and redo the change.

article_version.description: The article_version of the article this markdown was written from. Recommended: without it, an edit someone else made since is overwritten.

markdown.description: Updated article content as markdown with <SCREENSHOT {id}> placeholders

name: update_article
title: Update article
